verses.he: וַיֹּ֥סֶף אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Elihu also proceeded, and said:

verses.he: כַּתַּר־לִ֣י זְ֭עֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּ֑ךָּ כִּ֤י ע֖וֹד לֶאֱל֣וֹהַּ מִלִּֽים׃
verses.en: Suffer me a little, and I will tell thee; For there are yet words on God’s behalf.

verses.he: אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִי לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּ֝לְפֹעֲלִ֗י אֶֽתֵּֽן־צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, And will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

verses.he: כִּֽי־אָ֭מְנָם לֹא־שֶׁ֣קֶר מִלָּ֑י תְּמִ֖ים דֵּע֣וֹת עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: For truly my words are not false; One that is upright in mind is with thee.

verses.he: הֶן־אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר וְלֹ֣א יִמְאָ֑ס כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב׃
verses.en: Behold, God is mighty, yet He despiseth not any; He is mighty in strength of understanding.

verses.he: לֹא־יְחַיֶּ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃
verses.en: He preserveth not the life of the wicked; But giveth to the poor their right.

verses.he: לֹֽא־יִגְרַ֥ע מִצַּדִּ֗יק עֵ֫ינָ֥יו וְאֶת־מְלָכִ֥ים לַכִּסֵּ֑א וַיֹּשִׁיבֵ֥ם לָ֝נֶ֗צַח וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ׃
verses.en: He withdraweth not His eyes from the righteous; But with kings upon the throne He setteth them for ever, and they are exalted.

verses.he: וְאִם־אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּזִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּן בְּחַבְלֵי־עֹֽנִי׃
verses.en: And if they be bound in fetters, And be holden in cords of affliction;

verses.he: וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֣ם פָּעֳלָ֑ם וּ֝פִשְׁעֵיהֶ֗ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ׃
verses.en: Then He declareth unto them their work, And their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

verses.he: וַיִּ֣גֶל אָ֭זְנָם לַמּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־יְשֻׁב֥וּן מֵאָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: He openeth also their ear to discipline, And commandeth that they return from iniquity.

verses.he: אִֽם־יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽיַ֫עֲבֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֣ם בַּטּ֑וֹב וּ֝שְׁנֵיהֶ֗ם בַּנְּעִימִֽים׃
verses.en: If they hearken and serve Him, They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.

verses.he: וְאִם־לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁ֣לַח יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ֝יִגְוְע֗וּ כִּבְלִי־דָֽעַת׃
verses.en: But if they hearken not, they shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.

verses.he: וְֽחַנְפֵי־לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽם׃
verses.en: But they that are godless in heart lay up anger; They cry not for help when He bindeth them.

verses.he: תָּמֹ֣ת בַּנֹּ֣עַר נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם בַּקְּדֵשִֽׁים׃
verses.en: Their soul perisheth in youth, And their life as that of the depraved.

verses.he: יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְעָנְי֑וֹ וְיִ֖גֶל בַּלַּ֣חַץ אָזְנָֽם׃
verses.en: He delivereth the afflicted by His affliction, And openeth their ear by tribulation.

verses.he: וְאַ֤ף הֲסִיתְךָ֨׀ מִפִּי־צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא־מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְנַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן׃
verses.en: Yea, He hath allured thee out of distress Into a broad place, where there is no straitness; And that which is set on thy table is full of fatness;

verses.he: וְדִין־רָשָׁ֥ע מָלֵ֑אתָ דִּ֖ין וּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃
verses.en: And thou art full of the judgment of the wicked; Judgment and justice take hold on them.

verses.he: כִּֽי־חֵ֭מָה פֶּן־יְסִֽיתְךָ֣ בְסָ֑פֶק וְרָב־כֹּ֝֗פֶר אַל־יַטֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.en: For beware of wrath, lest thou be led away by thy sufficiency; Neither let the greatness of the ransom turn thee aside.

verses.he: הֲיַעֲרֹ֣ךְ שׁ֖וּעֲךָ לֹ֣א בְצָ֑ר וְ֝כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי־כֹֽחַ׃
verses.en: Will thy riches avail, that are without stint, Or all the forces of thy strength?

verses.he: אַל־תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַלָּ֑יְלָה לַעֲל֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.en: Desire not the night, When peoples are cut off in their place.

verses.he: הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל־תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל־אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־עַל־זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי׃
verses.en: Take heed, regard not iniquity; For this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

verses.he: הֶן־אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּכֹח֑וֹ מִ֖י כָמֹ֣הוּ מוֹרֶֽה׃
verses.en: Behold, God doeth loftily in His power; Who is a teacher like Him?

verses.he: מִֽי־פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִֽי־אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.en: Who hath enjoined Him His way? Or who hath said: ‘Thou hast wrought unrighteousness’?

verses.he: זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי־תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פָעֳל֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר שֹׁרְר֣וּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.en: Remember that thou magnify His work, Whereof men have sung.

verses.he: כָּל־אָדָ֥ם חָֽזוּ־ב֑וֹ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.en: All men have looked thereon; Man beholdeth it afar off.

verses.he: הֶן־אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣יו וְלֹא־חֵֽקֶר׃
verses.en: Behold, God is great, beyond our knowledge; The number of His years is unsearchable.

verses.he: כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי־מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְאֵדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For He draweth away the drops of water, Which distil rain from His vapour;

verses.he: אֲשֶֽׁר־יִזְּל֥וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ עֲלֵ֤י׀ אָדָ֬ם רָֽב׃
verses.en: Which the skies pour down And drop upon the multitudes of men.

verses.he: אַ֣ף אִם־יָ֭בִין מִפְרְשֵׂי־עָ֑ב תְּ֝שֻׁא֗וֹת סֻכָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Yea, can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, The crashings of His pavilion?

verses.he: הֵן־פָּרַ֣שׂ עָלָ֣יו אוֹר֑וֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַיָּ֣ם כִּסָּֽה׃
verses.en: Behold, He spreadeth His light upon it; And He covereth the depths of the sea.

verses.he: כִּי־בָ֭ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן־אֹ֥כֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר׃
verses.en: For by these He judgeth the peoples; He giveth food in abundance.

verses.he: עַל־כַּפַּ֥יִם כִּסָּה־א֑וֹר וַיְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣יהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ׃
verses.en: He covereth His hands with the lightning, And giveth it a charge that it strike the mark.

verses.he: יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו רֵע֑וֹ מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל־עוֹלֶֽה׃
verses.en: The noise thereof telleth concerning it, The cattle also concerning the storm that cometh up.
